title: Windows of Influence — combined Illustrator-authored static geometry and layout reference
purpose: Give Codex one source of truth for the static WoI graph: nine relationship trajectories, two stimulus trajectories, property/circle marker positions, seven authored Window-of-Influence boxes with leaders, and event/window label positions. The JSON preserves Illustrator geometry/layout while keeping research semantics/events as a separate model.

label SVG plot axis; top labels have negative y_plot_fraction and window labels exceed 1.0

provenance.relationship_curve_note: Curve Data(2).svg is byte-identical to the previously processed Curve Data(1).svg (sha256 dea9364ed91cfc6d56ca73c3c61bc90dc8a98f177e880f51048311980ac6efd4). The relationship geometry below is therefore reused without alteration.
important: Illustrator geometry is the visual/static reference, not a replacement for the research/event database.
Relationship events remain semantic data; they must not regenerate or smooth the nine relationship paths.
Window event definitions remain semantic data. The authored window boxes in this file are the calibration/visual target.
Property/entity meanings remain in the WoI database. Marker locations in this file are authoritative visual positions; do not infer property names from marker patterns alone.
Animation is explicitly out of scope until the static composition matches the authored reference.

target_coordinate_system.critical_rule: Each Illustrator export has its own registration. Apply the registration for that layer; do not assume all source SVG viewBoxes share the same top/baseline coordinates.

rendering_contract_for_codex: Load this JSON as an external data asset; do not copy hundreds of coordinates into the HTML.

Render layers in a stable order: state/background fields (existing) -> stimulus curves -> relationship curves -> property markers -> window boxes -> labels/leaders (or adjust z-order only to match the reference).
Use relationship paths from relationship_trajectories exactly. No Catmull–Rom, automatic support points, peak-radius heuristics, or event-based spline reconstruction.
Use STC-01 and STC-02 source path d values exactly and affinely transform their entire source group into the target plot.
Use marker centres/radii from property_markers exactly for static placement. Preserve the source visual key where possible, but keep semantic entity IDs separate.
Render the seven authored window boxes and their corresponding leaders from window_geometry. Do not create seven equal timeline phases.
Keep Window-of-Influence event definitions in the existing data model. Treat Illustrator window geometry as the visual calibration target for later event-derived geometry.
Use label anchors and line breaks from labels. Use website typography/CSS rather than requiring Effra if the project does not load that font.
Preserve round corners on window boxes and the broken/dashed red leader language.
Do not add or change Closed Parameter Space/system-boundary graphics from this file; no system-boundary SVG was supplied in this upload.
Do not animate anything until the complete static graph is visually approved.

Each red window box uses its paired Illustrator leader geometry.
All 15 authored logical circle-marker positions are preserved, including the literal G marker.
Top event/stimulus labels and bottom window labels use the Illustrator layout anchors.
No event-generated spline geometry is active for the nine relationship trajectories.
